segments.name: hook
segments.text: Haddii aad jeceshihiin misk jilicsan, kan waa inaad aragtaan!

segments.name: notes
segments.text: Kashmir Musk oo ka socda Arabian Oud: pear, jasmine, misk iyo patchouli.

segments.name: cta
segments.text: Waxaad ka heli kartaan Falarosa Luxury, Surrey. Nala soo xiriira!
